patch_description: Improvement over the original: the original picks the GPU with the lowest KVPR *before* placing the model, which ignores how the placement changes the ratio. Instead, for each model we evaluate the KVPR of each candidate GPU *after* adding the model (sum(r/s)/(mem - sum(size))) and choose the GPU yielding the smallest resulting KVPR. Then a simple local-search pass repeatedly tries moving one model from the worst-KVPR GPU to another GPU if it lowers the global maximum KVPR. This keeps the code simple, fast, and correctly memory-feasible, while lowering max KVPR.
